groupTitle: Nike Air Max 270 - Boys' Grade School

model.name: Nike Air Max 270 - Boys' Grade School
model.description:
The Nike Air Max 270 is a grade-school lifestyle sneaker built for school days, weekends, and everyday wear. A breathable mesh and synthetic upper helps keep the feel light, while dual-density foam works with the 270-degree visible Max Air unit in the heel for cushioned impact protection. A TPU heel clip adds structure through the back of the shoe for a more stable ride.

Nike Air Max 270 features:

  • 270-degree visible Max Air unit cushions heel impact.
  • Dual-density foam midsole balances soft cushioning and support.
  • Mesh and synthetic upper improves breathability and durability.
  • TPU heel clip adds rearfoot stability.
  • Rubber outsole delivers durable traction for everyday wear.
